description: Calm Morning Music | Sitar Instrumental | 3 Hours of Indian Classical Music for a slow, peaceful start to your day.

Let the morning arrive gently. Three unhurried hours of warm, meditative sitar in Raga Bhairavi — soft enough to keep in the background while you wake up slowly, journal, stretch, or ease into focused work, calm enough to let your mind settle before the day picks up speed.
No ads interrupting the calm. Just continuous, flowing Indian classical music for a mindful morning.
Best for: slow mornings · morning routine · gentle focus & study · meditation · a quiet, unrushed start.
Find a comfortable place, take a slow breath, and let the morning unfold at its own pace. 🌅
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — gentle flowing Indian classical sitar in Raga Bhairavi, warm plucked sitar with meend glissando slides and soft gamak ornamentation, light supportive tabla, unhurried ~70 BPM, calm devotional morning character, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: Morning-lane rule: NO 'slow' — used 'gentle/flowing/unhurried' + BPM ~70 (calm-background register, low enough to hold AVD across 3hr but not draggy). Sitar rule: named raga (Bhairavi) + ONE physical descriptor (meend/gamak) + LIGHT TABLA (every high-perf Sitar had tabla). Bhairavi = calm devotional morning.
